ids=$(grep -ho "id:'\(neon\|haunted\|space\)-[0-9][0-9]'" src/courses/data/*.ts | sort); test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 27; test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | uniq | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 27
